name: A bAV pension of 300 a month next to the DRV pension, KVdR
workings: Health on the bAV: the full rate (14.6% + 2.9%) on the part above 197.75 a month: 17.5% × 102.25 × 12 = 214.725
Care: 300 > 197.75 a month, so on all of it: 4.2% × 3,600 = 151.20 (below 197.75 there'd be none: a cliff)
The bAV is fully taxable; the €102 lump sum is already used by the DRV pension
realWageGrowth 0 keeps the allowance at 2026's 197.75 (by default it grows with wages after 2026)
